summary: Apple's framework presents a system sheet that generates images from text concepts and an optional source image, using Apple's own image-generation service. BifrOSt has no equivalent generation service and no counterpart to the system sheet, so the framework has no sensible BifrOSt counterpart.

features.note: Apple-hosted system sheet; no BifrOSt counterpart
system view controller tied to Apple's generation service
needs an on-device or cloud image model that BifrOSt does not ship
input types for the Apple generation service only
options for the Apple generation service only
